assertion_analysis.failure_condition: the skipif marker reddens the file into a SKIP (not a pass) when git cat-file cannot resolve 511a22e06^:nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py; the added control is positive on the skip direction (empty GIT_DIR run logged SKIPPED with the named reason) but no committed assertion fails if the availability probe itself regresses.

findings.text: follow-on: the added skip turns a missing reference object into a silent pass, so the receipt-identity guard this node exists to add can be absent in a shallow clone or any tree without 511a22e06 while the default lane stays green; the guard then reports safety it does not provide for a reason unrelated to the code under test.

follow-on: no committed test asserts the skip path, so a regression in _receipt_reference_available (for example a constant False, or a git binary absent so subprocess.run raises at import) leaves the whole receipt guard inert and the suite green; the availability control is verified only by an uncommitted run-local log.
